posts.title: How I’m writing web apps with Nim in 2026
posts.description: A few things have changed in the Nim webdev community since I last wrote in 2021 . The main update is that Jester is effectively in maintenance mode, and has some issues with the latest version of Nim. posts.title: Android gaming on a budget
posts.description: I've never really been much of a PC gamer - growing up, I mostly played on various Nintendo consoles.
